 def kth(arr, k):
+    if not arr:
+        raise ValueError('Array is empty')
+    pivot = arr[0]
+    below = [x for x in arr if x < pivot]
+    above = [x for x in arr if x > pivot]
+    if k == len(below):
+        return pivot
+    elif k < len(below):
+        return kth(below, k)
+    else:
+        return kth(above, k - len(below) - 1)
     pivot = arr[0]
     below = [x for x in arr if x < pivot]
     above = [x for x in arr if x > pivot]
